$comment: FROZEN CONTRACT for the REST transport's per-message payload (capture.py _deliver_rest).
CodingAgentMessage) declares extra='forbid': ONE unknown key rejects the ENTIRE message
with a 422, taking every valid field down with it. There is no partial acceptance.
So a new key is a BREAKING change and must land server-first:
1. add the field to the gateway model + a consumer for it, deploy;
2. only then add it here and start sending it.
History: codecollab de68953 (2026-07-31) added 'repositoriesTouched' for a multi-repo
fan-out feature whose server half was never built. No repo ever consumed it, and because
of extra='forbid' it 422'd every message whenever linkage was enabled — silently breaking
the sessionId/turnIndex fields the gateway HAD added the same day (ff9b684). Removed in
0.12.0. This file exists so that cannot happen twice.
Both sides test against this fixture; keep the copies in sync:
codecollab: scripts/test_capture.py  (asserts emitted keys are a subset of allowed)

notes.type: Optional; 'remember' (default) or 'get'. capture.py never sends it.
notes.commitId: Must be exactly 40 hex chars, or the message 422s.
notes.timestamp: Must include a timezone offset — a naive datetime is rejected.
notes.branch: Requires repositoryName; branch/commitId without it is rejected.
notes.sessionId: Becomes the server's conversation key. Absent, the server derives a stable id from (tenant, user, repository, branch), collapsing every turn into one conversation.
notes.turnIndex: Rendered into the message's text prefix only; no structural effect.
notes.repositories_touched: NOT a key here, deliberately. The per-turn repository report (0.17.0) ships only on the becos transport, inside metadata.event.metadata — a free-form bag, so it breaks no strict model. This REST payload has no free-form field, so carrying it would need a gateway change first. Same reasoning that removed repositoriesTouched in 0.12.0.
notes.Idempotency-Key: Sent as a HEADER, not a body key. Must be a UUID; required for 'remember'.
